title: Mind Over Matter: The Epic Crossing of the Antarctic Continent
excerpt: An incredible story about human perseverance and grit. Follows Sir Ranulph Fiennes and Mike Stroud on their man haul journey across Antarctica.
content: An incredible story about human perseverance and grit. Follows Sir Ranulph Fiennes and Mike Stroud on their man haul journey across Antarctica. The book doesn't shy away from the harshness of the expedition, you can really get a sense of how brutal it was. I particularly liked the focus on some of the physiological research they did on the deterioration of their bodies over the course of the trek. Parts of the book are written quite matter-of-factly but the story is interesting enough that this isn't much of a negative. Just stating the facts of the expedition is enough to illustrate what it was like. It's hard to read this and not be inspired to be more adventurous in your own life.
